en: The Statue of Liberty stands in New York Harbor. It was a gift from France in 1886.
uz: Ozodlik haykali Nyu-York bandargohida turibdi. U 1886-yilda Fransiyaning sovg'asi bo'lgan.

en: Big Ben is the famous clock tower in London. Its bell rings every hour.
uz: Big Ben — Londondagi mashhur soat minorasi. Uning qo'ng'irog'i har soatda chalinadi.

en: The Grand Canyon is in Arizona. It is about 1.8 kilometres deep.
uz: Buyuk kanyon Arizona shtatida joylashgan. Uning chuqurligi taxminan 1,8 kilometr.

en: Tower Bridge crosses the River Thames in London. The middle of the bridge can open for big ships.
uz: Tauer ko'prigi Londonda Temza daryosi ustidan o'tadi. Katta kemalar uchun ko'prikning o'rtasi ochiladi.

en: The Golden Gate Bridge is in San Francisco. Its colour is called "international orange".
uz: Oltin darvoza ko'prigi San-Fransiskoda joylashgan. Uning rangi «xalqaro to'q sariq» deb ataladi.

en: Stonehenge is a circle of huge stones in England. People built it about 5,000 years ago.
uz: Stounhenj — Angliyadagi ulkan toshlardan iborat aylana. Odamlar uni taxminan 5000 yil oldin qurishgan.

en: Times Square is in the centre of New York. It is full of bright lights day and night.
uz: Tayms-skver Nyu-York markazida joylashgan. U kechayu kunduz yorqin chiroqlarga to'la.

en: Edinburgh Castle stands on an old volcanic rock. It is the most famous place in Scotland.
uz: Edinburg qal'asi qadimgi vulqon qoyasi ustida turibdi. Bu Shotlandiyadagi eng mashhur joy.

en: Niagara Falls is on the border of the USA and Canada. Millions of tourists visit it every year.
uz: Niagara sharsharasi AQSh va Kanada chegarasida joylashgan. Uni har yili millionlab sayyohlar ko'radi.

en: Buckingham Palace is the home of the British king in London. It has 775 rooms.
uz: Bukingem saroyi — Britaniya qirolining Londondagi qarorgohi. Unda 775 ta xona bor.

en: The Capitol is in Washington, D.C. The US Congress works in this building.
uz: Kapitoliy Vashingtonda joylashgan. AQSh Kongressi shu binoda ishlaydi.

en: The London Eye is a giant wheel next to the River Thames. From the top you can see all of London.
uz: London ko'zi — Temza daryosi yonidagi ulkan charxpalak. Uning tepasidan butun London ko'rinadi.

en: Yellowstone was the first national park in the world. It has hot springs and geysers.
uz: Yelloustoun dunyodagi birinchi milliy bog' bo'lgan. Unda issiq buloqlar va geyzerlar bor.

en: Oxford is home to the oldest university in the English-speaking world. Students have studied here for more than 900 years.
uz: Oksfordda ingliz tilida so'zlashuvchi dunyodagi eng qadimgi universitet bor. Bu yerda 900 yildan ortiq vaqtdan beri talabalar o'qiydi.

en: Four US presidents are carved into the rock of Mount Rushmore. Each face is about 18 metres tall.
uz: Rashmor tog'i qoyasiga to'rtta AQSh prezidentining yuzi o'yib ishlangan. Har bir yuzning balandligi taxminan 18 metr.

en: The Lake District is in the north of England. It is famous for its lakes, hills and walking paths.
uz: Ko'llar o'lkasi Angliyaning shimolida joylashgan. U ko'llari, tepaliklari va piyoda yo'laklari bilan mashhur.

en: Chicago is a big city on Lake Michigan. The first skyscraper in the world was built here.
uz: Chikago — Michigan ko'li bo'yidagi katta shahar. Dunyodagi birinchi osmono'par bino shu yerda qurilgan.

en: The Isle of Skye is an island in Scotland. It has wild mountains and beautiful sea views.
uz: Skay oroli — Shotlandiyadagi orol. Unda yovvoyi tog'lar va chiroyli dengiz manzaralari bor.

en: Yosemite is a national park in California. It is famous for its giant rocks and waterfalls.
uz: Yosemiti — Kaliforniyadagi milliy bog'. U ulkan qoyalari va sharsharalari bilan mashhur.

en: Windsor Castle is the oldest castle in the world where people still live. The royal family often stays here.
uz: Vindzor qal'asi — hali ham odamlar yashaydigan dunyodagi eng qadimgi qal'a. Qirollik oilasi bu yerda tez-tez bo'ladi.

en: Monument Valley has tall red rocks in the desert. You can see it in many Western films.
uz: Monument vodiysida cho'l o'rtasida baland qizil qoyalar bor. Uni ko'plab vestern filmlarida ko'rish mumkin.

en: Cambridge is a famous university city. Students often go boating on the river here.
uz: Kembrij — mashhur universitet shahri. Bu yerda talabalar ko'pincha daryoda qayiqda suzishadi.

en: The Empire State Building is in New York. It has 102 floors.
uz: Empayr-Steyt-Bilding Nyu-Yorkda joylashgan. Unda 102 ta qavat bor.

en: Bath is a beautiful old city in England. The Romans built baths here around 2,000 years ago.
uz: Bat — Angliyadagi chiroyli qadimiy shahar. Rimliklar bu yerda taxminan 2000 yil oldin hammomlar qurishgan.

en: Las Vegas is a city in the Nevada desert. It is famous for its big hotels and shows.
uz: Las-Vegas — Nevada cho'lidagi shahar. U katta mehmonxonalari va shoulari bilan mashhur.

en: The Giant's Causeway is in Northern Ireland. It has about 40,000 stone columns made by a volcano.
uz: Gigant yo'li Shimoliy Irlandiyada joylashgan. Unda vulqon hosil qilgan 40 mingga yaqin tosh ustun bor.

en: Hawaii is a group of islands in the Pacific Ocean. People go there for the beaches and warm weather.
uz: Gavayi — Tinch okeanidagi orollar guruhi. Odamlar u yerga plyajlar va iliq ob-havo uchun borishadi.

en: Snowdon is the highest mountain in Wales. You can walk to the top or take a train.
uz: Snoudon — Uelsdagi eng baland tog'. Uning cho'qqisiga piyoda chiqish yoki poyezdda borish mumkin.

en: The Hollywood Sign is on a hill in Los Angeles. Each letter is about 14 metres tall.
uz: Gollivud yozuvi Los-Anjelesdagi tepalikda turibdi. Har bir harfning balandligi taxminan 14 metr.

en: The White Cliffs of Dover look over the sea towards France. On a clear day you can see the French coast.
uz: Duvrning oq qoyalari dengiz orqali Fransiya tomonga qaraydi. Havo ochiq kunda Fransiya qirg'og'i ko'rinadi.
